abilities.name: Ice-Breaking Light
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 1% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single enemy and gains 1 stack of Magma Will.

abilities.name: Ever-Burning Amber
abilities.text: Increases the Trailblazer's DMG Reduction by 0.5% and gains 1 stack of Magma Will, with a 1% base chance to Taunt all enemies for 1 turn(s).

abilities.name: War-Flaming Lance
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 1% of the Trailblazer's ATK plus 1.5% of the Trailblazer's DEF to all enemies. The next Basic ATK will be automatically enhanced and does not cost Magma Will.

abilities.name: Treasure of the Architects
abilities.text:
Each time the Trailblazer is hit, they gain 1 stack of Magma Will for a max of 8 stack(s).
When Magma Will has no fewer than 4 stacks, the Trailblazer's Basic ATK becomes enhanced, dealing DMG to a single enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
When the Trailblazer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, apply a Shield to all allies that absorbs DMG equal to 0.06% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 80. The Shield lasts for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Call of the Guardian
abilities.text: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to 0.3% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 384 for 1 turn(s).

abilities.name: The Strong Defend the Weak
abilities.desc: After using the Skill, the DMG taken by all allies reduces by 15% for 1 turn(s).

abilities.name: Unwavering Gallantry
abilities.desc: Using Enhanced Basic ATK restores the Trailblazer's HP by 5% of their Max HP.

abilities.name: Action Beats Overthinking
abilities.desc: When the Trailblazer is protected by a Shield at the beginning of the turn, increases ATK by 15% and regenerates 5 Energy until the action is over.

abilities.name: Earth-Shaking Resonance
abilities.desc: When the Trailblazer uses their Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 25% of the Trailblazer's DEF. When the Trailblazer uses their enhanced Basic ATK, deal Additional Fire DMG equal to 50% of the Trailblazer's DEF.

abilities.name: Time-Defying Tenacity
abilities.desc: The Shield applied to all allies from the Trailblazer's Talent will block extra DMG equal to 2% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 27.

abilities.name: Trail-Blazing Blueprint
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Nation-Building Oath
abilities.desc: At the start of the battle, immediately gains 4 stack(s) of Magma Will.

abilities.name: Spirit-Warming Flame
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: City-Forging Bulwarks
abilities.desc: After the Trailblazer use enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate, their DEF increases by 10%. Stacks up to 3 time(s).
